problems: Cross-dossier gaps (not editable by this batch): mamluk-dynasty has the 1226 Ranthambore gain but no loss c. 1236-1240 (Razia) to chahamanas-of-ranastambhapura; mughal-empire has no 1620 Kangra loss/vassal_start and no 1789 loss to kangra-state; qing-dynasty and kashmir-and-jammu lack the Hunza tribute (from c. 1760; Dogras 1860); langah-sultanate ends 1528 while its infobox says 1530.
hunza-and-nagar is really two states (Hunza c. 1200, Nagar c. 1300); kept as one dossier and one 70 km disc because four dossiers cite one slug and one region; split only if the renderers need it.

chalukyas-of-lata: the dynasty page (c. 970-c. 1070) conflicts with the Chaulukya, Paramara and Western Chalukya ledgers; the 970 found event over Lata proper will be a compiler conflict that rule R2 (Chaulukya lists it as predecessor) should settle for the Chaulukyas; only 1009-1017 is the dynasty's own land. No capital on the page, so identity.capitals is empty.

panduvamshi-dynasty is the Dakshina Kosala line (the article title 'Panduvamshi dynasty' does not load, 'Panduvamshis of Dakshina Kosala' does); nala-dynasty lists it as successor on the Nala page's 'probably supplanted' but the Dakshina Kosala page says the Nalas came later; somavamshi-dynasty's 'Kalachuris drove the Panduvamshis out' is 'one theory' undated on the Somavamshi page. The land 790-882 is nobody's.

kangra-state and arghun-dynasty rest on thin pages: the founding years (1050, 'the 11th century'; 620 and 790 for the Panduvamshis) are confidence-1 bridges; Wikidata ids are null for all six (wikidata.org is unreachable).

The sind-samma-dynasty successor and the langah-sultanate successor both name arghun-dynasty and the Arghun ledger mirrors their contest, gain and dissolve events (1520; 1525-1528). No alias found: janapada-of-kosala is the ancient janapada, not Dakshina Kosala.
